snippets.snippet: Application for Zoning Certificate Benton Township, Ottawa County, Ohio Application Number To the Board of Township Trustees: The undersigned hereby applies for a Zoning Certificate for the following use, to be issued on the basis of the following representations contained herein, all of which the applicant says are true. Location of property: Name of land owner: Address and Phone #: Check the Proposed Use: One-Family Dwelling Two-Family Dwelling Multi-Family Dwelling Trailer Courts Residential Addition Commercial Industrial Garages/Accessory Buildings Fences/Decks Signs Swimming Pools Retention Ponds Wind-Powered Generator Towers Other/Explain Provide an attached sheet with a plot plan of the address in concern. On this plot plan, provide all boundary measurements – locations of existing buildings – septic system and well. Provide with dotted lines the proposed new construction. • Indic
